etymology.historical_story: Claybourne appears among the surnames documented by the Claybourn Genealogical Society. Its research draws on family records, letters, photographs and other historical materials. This establishes a family-name context, but does not identify the person behind an isolated corpus token. A precise origin or pronunciation should therefore be tied to a documented family rather than inferred from spelling alone. [Source](https://claybourn.org/about/)
